java.io.File outFile = outputPath.resolve("test_sink.png").toFile();
net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.FileImageSink sink = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.FileImageSink(outFile, true);

// Exercise the sink by writing the provided in-memory image to the file
sink.write(sourceImage);

// Read back the output to verify the sink correctly wrote the image data
java.awt.image.BufferedImage readBack = javax.imageio.ImageIO.read(outFile);
assert readBack != null : "Image should be written and readable";
assert readBack.getWidth() == sourceImage.getWidth() : "Width mismatch in written image";
assert readBack.getHeight() == sourceImage.getHeight() : "Height mismatch in written image";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ FileImageSink " + outFile.exists() + "," + readBack.getWidth() + "x" + readBack.getHeight());
